parts.text: Mark is trying to choose between two venues for a surprise party for his wife.
The first venue charges a flat fee of $300, regardless of how many guests attend.
The second location, on the other hand, charges $30 per person.
However, the first venue does not include food, which John estimates will cost $10 for each guest.
At the second location, food for each guest is already included in the price.
How many guests are necessary for the two venues to be equal in cost?
